# Psalm 36 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

## 36:1 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** For-the-choirmaster. Of-the-servant of-YHWH, of-David.
- **LOGOS:** For the choirmaster. Of David, the servant of the LORD.
- **PNEUMA:** For the music director. A psalm of David, the servant of the LORD.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 36:3 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** For it-flatters-him in-his-eyes, to-find his-iniquity, to-hate.
- **LOGOS:** For he flatters himself in his own eyes that his iniquity cannot be found out and hated.
- **PNEUMA:** In their blind conceit, they cannot see how wicked they really are.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 36:4 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** The-words of-his-mouth [are] iniquity and-deceit; he-has-ceased to-act-wisely, to-do-good.
- **LOGOS:** The words of his mouth are trouble and deceit; he has ceased to act wisely and do good.
- **PNEUMA:** Everything they say is crooked and deceitful. They refuse to act wisely or do good.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 36:6 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** YHWH, in-the-heavens [is] Your-steadfast-love; Your-faithfulness [reaches] to-the-clouds.
- **LOGOS:** Your steadfast love, O LORD, extends to the heavens, Your faithfulness to the clouds.
- **PNEUMA:** Your unfailing love, LORD, is as vast as the heavens; Your faithfulness reaches beyond the clouds.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 36:9 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** They-feast on-the-abundance of-Your-house, and-the-river of-Your-delights You-give-them-to-drink.
- **LOGOS:** They feast on the abundance of Your house, and You give them drink from the river of Your delights.
- **PNEUMA:** You feed them from the abundance of Your own house, letting them drink from Your river of delights.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 36:11 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Extend Your-steadfast-love to-those-who-know-You, and-Your-righteousness to-the-upright of-heart.
- **LOGOS:** Oh, continue Your steadfast love to those who know You, and Your righteousness to the upright of heart!
- **PNEUMA:** Pour out Your unfailing love on those who love You; give justice to those with honest hearts.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
